items.title: Jensen Huang discusses comeback as Nvidia CEO with allies: Report
items.description: The report comes days after the FT reported that Nvidia's board had approached British chipmaker Arm Holdings CEO Rene Haas in its search for a potential successor to Jensen Huang

items.description: Mahindra has invested several hundred million crore rupees in its latest capacity expansion and is evaluating locations for a larger manufacturing facility

items.title: Air India flights to US operated as scheduled without significant delays, says airline
items.description: More than 2,500 flights were cancelled in the US on Saturday, and hundreds more were delayed, according to FlightAware, a website that tracks flight disruptions

items.title: Patanjali Foods Q2 profit dips 19% to Rs 420 crore, revenue rises 16% to Rs 11,406 crore
items.description: Of total revenue from operations, the edible oil business contributed Rs 8,532 crore, while the FMCG segment generated Rs 2,923 crore.

items.title: Ashok Leyland Q2 profit rises 13% to Rs 869 crore, revenue jumps 39%
items.description: Ashok Leyland’s second-quarter performance saw commercial vehicle volumes cross 64,000 units, while the company reported gains in its domestic truck and light commercial vehicle market shares.
